title: Jesus' Intervention Just Arrived  - JIJA
description: A low-health visual and audio effect mod inspired by relatively old Minecraft memes, late-night caffeine, and questionable survival decisions.
body:
Ever been one hit away from death and completely missed it?

When your health gets critically low, JIJA adds a dramatic visual and audio warning. A heavenly image appears on screen accompanied by church bells, making sure you know you're about to make some very bad decisions.

Features:

- Full-screen visual warning at low health
- Church bell sound effect
- Smooth fade-in and fade-out animation
- Lightweight client-side mod

This mod exists because a desire to have such mod... turned into a programming project. If you want to improve it in one way or another, let me know or do just that yourself.
